decisions.statement: Bounded editing is limited by the least-bounded channel, not by the edit verb set
decisions.support: 30-surface census: all seven verbs near-universal; three boundary postures; every AI builder shows unbounded fallthrough
decisions.falsifier: A system with an ungated chat channel nevertheless preserves compositional properties under audit

decisions.statement: Store intent, not mutation; upgrade safety is a property of what was stored
decisions.support: No surveyed surface durably records why; coordinate-bound edits cannot survive node movement
decisions.falsifier: Stored intents fail to re-resolve on a real minor-version upgrade

decisions.statement: Out-of-bounds edits must be unrepresentable, not merely blocked
decisions.support: Storyblok whitelists and Power Apps managed layers are the only architecturally sound posture observed
decisions.falsifier: A donor whose editable surface cannot be typed without rewriting it

decisions.statement: Layer separation is necessary but not sufficient for upgrade safety
decisions.support: Verified: Shopify OS2.0 settings layer reportedly wiped on theme update, Mar 2026, two independent merchant reports plus staff acknowledgement of receipt
decisions.falsifier: A per-upgrade snapshot/diff gate proves unnecessary across a representative donor set

decisions.statement: Adopt `deferred` as a fourth edit outcome
decisions.support: Local siso-ui-base gate reports DNA-overridden values as deferred without failing the run
decisions.falsifier: Clients cannot distinguish deferred from denied in practice

decisions.statement: Open Design is not a live foundation
decisions.support: opendesigndev org last activity 3 Sep 2024; nothing 2025-2026; open-design.ai is an unrelated agent wrapper; ODA is unrelated CAD/BIM
decisions.falsifier: Evidence of active 2026 maintenance on the Open Design Engine or Octopus spec

decisions.statement: Data-binding is the highest-risk verb and must be scope-gated
decisions.support: Only verb that alters what data the app touches; market UIs weight it like a style change
decisions.falsifier: A binding model that provably cannot widen scope regardless of gating

decisions.statement: Commercial denominator is 30, not ~100 — depth contract unmet
decisions.support: Account-wide quota terminated the sweep; no padding performed
decisions.falsifier: A completed continuation wave closes it
